full_read_justified.instructions: Given the goal, target, known size, proposed read, and already-read context, estimate the calibrated belief that reading the full file or full tree is genuinely needed rather than a bounded search or range.

read_strategy.instructions: Choose the most context-efficient read strategy that still satisfies the goal.

criteria.targeted_search: Search narrowly for the needed symbol, phrase, or file path before reading content.
criteria.ranged_read: Read only a bounded line range or focused section.
criteria.full_read: Read the full file or scope because the whole content is justified.
criteria.already_have_it: The needed information is already in context; skip the read.

expected_relevance.instructions: Score how relevant the proposed read scope is expected to be to the current goal.
